newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 46-day T-bills yield limit gross 17.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech 46-day T-bills yield limit gross 17.9 pct.

text.p: Gross yield in a Czech National Bank (CNB) auction of a six billion crown tranche of Finance Ministry 46-day treasury bills reached the maximum permissable limit of 17.9 percent, and the auction was underscribed, the CNB said.
The central bank said net yield was 13.425, with all bids accepted. The auction was undersubscribed with bids totalling 5.06 billion crowns. The CNB said it bought the remainder.
